## VantaVault v0.5.32

Know when a saved account needs you before it drops out, and a tidier Map tab.

### Highlights
- **Accounts that need you** (accounts): The account button shows a badge when a saved account needs a new sign-in or its Riot login ends within 3 days, and the account list says which.
- **Where your kills come from** (killspot): Takeaways on the Map tab now point out the spot your kills come from, next to where you keep dying.

### Improved
- Each saved account shows "Riot login ends in N days" when Riot has said when its login ends.
- The Map tab's Repeat positions are now part of Takeaways, so the same spot is not listed twice.
- VantaVault runs on the latest Tauri, Next.js and React.

### Fixed
- The What's new popup for 0.5.31 now has its drawn feature previews.

### Download
- **Windows Portable:** `VantaVault-portable.exe` — run directly with no setup.
- **Windows Installer:** `VantaVault_0.5.32_x64-setup.exe` — optional per-user installation.

### Auto-update
Both Windows release types update from inside VantaVault. Android debug and signed builds are produced through the repository workflows and are not published on Google Play.

**Full changelog:** https://github.com/akawazak/valo-project/compare/v0.5.31...v0.5.32
